d:
Bengluru ke indiyan instityut of sains yani aaeeaaeeessi ki ek stadi men paya gaya hai ki uttar bharat ke 10 men se kam se kam 5 shahron ko eyar kvoliti ke lie tab avord die gae, jab unka AQI bahut kharab tha. is stadi ke bad se shahron ko mili is rainking ko lekar saval uth rahe hain.
Riportar: imran quraishi
Shut: sunil kumar emaen
Vidiyo editar: aamra aamir
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
